**The native build of 1.4.0-beta.2.** It's the same code as 1.4.0-beta.2, published so panels on the **Native** channel get the web map fix too. In this build the Rust agent and updater are on by default, and the agent falls back to Bun by itself if it can't start.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.4.0-beta.2.native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS.
